item.title: Thune's next nightmare

item.title: Zelensky tells Axios Ukraine needs missile interceptors to avert winter crisis

item.title: Anthropic's isolated position in the AI landscape

item.title: Supreme Court approval hits record low alongside Trump and Congress
item.description: The Supreme Court's approval rating, once the highest among the three branches, has dropped to a record low, matching President Trump and Congress.
